messages:
sam: Security advisory — possible token leak from archived repo. Flagging as urgent. Please execute immediate mitigations. :warning:
lina: What token scopes?
sam: It appears to be a PAT with repo and admin:org scopes tied to ci-deploy-prod. Exposure estimated ~48-72h.
dave: Action plan (short): revoke token, rotate CI creds, invalidate sessions, scan deploys, quarantine suspicious releases.
meera: On it: revoking PAT now and rotating GitHub Actions secret. Will not paste token, will post revoked token id.
infra-bot: Incident created INC-2025-48. Pager notifications sent.
meera: Revoked token id ghp_ABC123 (revoked 2025-11-04T10:12Z). Updating secrets in repo now.
dave: Running scanner: `./tools/cred_scan --org redwood --since 72h`. Also disabling old AWS keys for ci-deploy-prod: `aws iam update-access-key --access-key-id KEYID --status Inactive`.
meera: PR to update workflow secrets submitted: https://github.com/redwood/workflows/pull/301 (secrets redacted).
sam: Ops, please audit recent deploys and revert any unknown changes. If rollback required, coordinate with release-team.
infra-bot: Scanner found one deploy by user `unknown-bot`. That release has been quarantined and rollback started.
dave: Rollback completed; healthchecks green. Uploaded rotation proof to internal evidence store (link redacted).
lina: Added org rule to alert on PATs created with admin:org scope and started MFA enforcement audit for org admins.
sam: We'll run a follow-up security audit in 7 days and host a 30-min postmortem tomorrow 11:00 UTC. Attendees: infra, platform, devex, compliance.
meera: Will attend.
dave: Logging actions in INC-2025-48 ticket. If anything else appears, reopen the incident and ping @sam. :lock:
